scenario_narratives.base: Kangyueda becomes a ~RMB4bn+ domestic type-2 inflammation franchise under NRDL and Essential Medicines List coverage, collaboration income normalises into recurring milestones and royalties (AZD0901, CM336), and operating leverage takes the company from a ~-23% adj. EBITDA margin in FY2026E to breakeven in FY2027 and ~32% by FY2033.
scenario_narratives.bull: CM512 succeeds as Kangyueda's successor, AZD0901 is approved with AstraZeneca and pays royalties, Gilead/Lakefront advance CM336 and pay the US$680m of contingent milestones, and the NewCo model repeats -- revenue ~RMB11bn by FY2036 at a 38% margin.
scenario_narratives.bear: Kangyueda is capped near RMB1.5-2bn by dupilumab's incumbency, domestic competition and NRDL price cuts; the pipeline disappoints and out-licensing dries up; the company burns cash to FY2028 and settles at a 19% margin on ~RMB2.8bn revenue.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Keymed is valued as an operating company on an owner-FCF DCF with a heavy forward normalisation, not as a pre-revenue rNPV and not as a holdco. Reasons: (1) it already has a commercial product growing >100% with national reimbursement, so the dominant value driver is a sales ramp and operating-leverage path that a component DCF models directly; (2) the dcf-methods routing table has no rNPV/milestone row, and an rNPV of ~12 partly-licensed assets would rest on probability-of-success guesses with no anchor in the filings; (3) the licensing/NewCo engine is real but lumpy, so it is normalised into a recurring collaboration-income stream inside revenue (base) and its upside (CM512, AZD0901 royalties, CM336 milestones) is priced through the bull scenario rather than added on top, which would double-count it. Historical FCF is negative every year and is NOT extrapolated; the H1 FY2026 Ouro gain is a one-off whose cash is in the bridge and whose deferred tax is deducted. FY0 is FY2026E so that Year 1 is the first full year after the 30 June balance sheet, with H2 FY2026 burn deducted in the bridge. The valuation is terminal-heavy by construction (no positive FCF until ~FY2028), and the gap to the market price is largely the market's pricing of pipeline optionality and China-biotech multiples above what a 10.5% RMB cost of equity supports.
key_risks_to_valuation: Single-product dependence: Kangyueda is ~all product revenue; an NRDL price cut or share loss to dupilumab moves every scenario
Pipeline binaries (CM512 Phase III, AZD0901 approval, CM336 pivotal) decide whether the bull case is reachable
Collaboration revenue is lumpy and partner-controlled; the base normalises it into a recurring stream that may not recur
Terminal-value dominance: most of the value sits beyond FY2030 because owner FCF is negative until ~FY2028
Further equity placings would dilute; the flat share count assumes the RMB3.2bn reserve is enough
US scrutiny of China-origin biotech licensing could close the out-licensing channel

inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in RMB: China 10Y government bond ~1.8% + beta 1.25 x China ERP ~6.8% = ~10.3%, rounded to 10.5% for a single-commercial-product HK-listed biotech. Company is net cash, so WACC = cost of equity. Same WACC in all three scenarios: clinical/single-product risk is charged in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight, not stacked as a discount-rate premium (adaptations 7f).

inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted -- with heavy normalisation. Routing: Keymed is an operating biopharma (product sales + licensing), not a bank/REIT/holdco/shell, so SKILL.md routes it to owner-FCF + adaptations (non-US, CNY flows vs HKD quote). It is early-commercial: historical owner FCF is uniformly negative (FY2025 reported FCF -1,048.9, owner FCF -1,144.0 after stripping SBC 27.8 and interest income 67.4), so no historical FCF series or margin can be carried forward. The value is therefore built entirely from a forward component path (revenue ramp of Kangyueda under NRDL/EML plus normalised collaboration/royalty income, EBITDA margin maturing from loss to a stated mature level), and pipeline optionality (CM512, AZD0901 royalties, CM336 milestones from Gilead/Lakefront) is priced through the bull scenario revenue and margin, not added as a separate rNPV -- see valuation_philosophy. FY0 = FY2026E (not FY2025): base_revenue 1,180 = Kangyueda ~850 (management/Citi raised guidance) + collaboration ~330 (H1 actual 224.4 incl. the ~US$45m AZ CLARITY-Gastric 02 milestone). Year 1 is therefore FY2027. Because the balance sheet is 30 June 2026, the estimated H2 FY2026 owner cash burn (~RMB250m) is deducted in equity_bridge so the cash is not counted before it is spent. Cash = cash and cash equivalents 2,339.4 + time deposits 556.1 + current bank wealth-management products (FVTPL) 331.6 = 3,227.1 (restricted cash 14.4 excluded). Debt = bank borrowings 677.4 (425.6 current + 251.8 non-current) + lease liabilities 19.3 = 696.7. Interest income (FY2025 67.4) stripped from last_fcf because the cash is added in the bridge; the forward flows are EBITDA-based and contain no interest income. The H1 FY2026 RMB1,639.5m fair-value gain on the Ouro Medicines disposal is excluded from every flow -- its cash (US$257m) is already in the 30 June cash balance, and its deferred tax (RMB265.3m DTL booked in H1) is deducted in the bridge. Buybacks: none since FY2024 (RSU trust purchases only), so the flat count is a modelling convention the company is not paying for in cash.

bear.narrative: Kangyueda stalls at ~RMB1.5-2bn: dupilumab's NRDL incumbency and a wave of domestic IL-4Ra/TSLP entrants force price cuts at the 2027 NRDL renegotiation; CM512 and the early pipeline fail or are deprioritised, collaboration revenue dries up after the AZ milestones as US scrutiny of China-origin licensing chills NewCo deals. Burn continues into FY2028, likely forcing another placing (not modelled as dilution; captured as continued negative flows). Revenue ~RMB2.8bn by FY2036 at a 19% mature margin.

base.narrative: Kangyueda reaches ~RMB4bn+ of China sales by the early 2030s under NRDL/EML access with modest price cuts at renegotiation, adolescent AD and prurigo nodularis labels approved; collaboration income normalises to a ~RMB1-1.5bn/yr stream of milestones and royalties (AZD0901 royalties from 2028, CM336 milestones). Mature adj. EBITDA margin 32% (high-80s gross margin, R&D held near 15-18% of sales, S&D scaling down as % of sales). Revenue ~RMB6.4bn by FY2036.
base.growth_note: FY2027 +52% on a full year of EML-driven county-hospital penetration and pen formulation; decelerates to 4% by FY2036 as the IL-4Ra class matures and biosimilar/competitor pressure arrives post-2035.
base.margin_note: FY2026E adj. EBITDA ~-23% (revenue 1,180 vs COGS ~255, R&D ~700, admin ~175, S&D ~470, plus D&A ~95 and SBC ~50 added back). Breakeven at adj. EBITDA in FY2027 is the operating-leverage step that H1 FY2026 already shows (H1 adj. EBITDA ~-77 on 617 revenue).
base.wc_note: Negative capture: trade receivables (210 at H1 vs 101 at Dec-25) and inventories grow with hospital channel sales; payables small. China hospital receivable days are long.
base.tax_note: Accumulated tax losses shelter FY2027-28; ramps to a ~17% blend (15% HNTE PRC rate plus 10% US withholding on milestone receipts).

bull.narrative: Pipeline pays: CM512 (TSLPxIL-13, ~70-day half-life) succeeds in Phase III CRSwNP/asthma and extends the franchise past Kangyueda; AZD0901 is approved in 2L+ gastric with AstraZeneca and pays high-single to low-double-digit royalties; Gilead/Lakefront take CM336 into pivotal trials and the US$70m + up to US$610m milestones start flowing; further NewCo exits recur. Revenue ~RMB11bn by FY2036 at a 38% mature margin.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default: single commercial product against an entrenched global leader, annual NRDL price renegotiation by a single payer, and a mostly Phase I/II pipeline. Base 50%: Kangyueda's ramp (+132% in H1 FY2026, raised FY2026 guidance, EML from Sept 2026) is already evidenced. Bull cut to 20%: it needs several independent binary events (CM512 Phase III, AZD0901 approval, CM336 pivotal success, further NewCo exits) to go right together.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
